name: c-sidebar-1
title: Application shell with a workspace switcher
label: Workspace Switcher
description: Grouped navigation with count badges, row menus and a footer account menu.

guidance.bestFor: An inset variant layout whose header dropdown switches the workspace named in the page breadcrumb, beside stat cards and a deploy list
agentNotes: Replace `WORKSPACES`, `NAV`, `PROJECTS`, `DEPLOYMENTS` and `STATS` with your data; the active Deployments row is hard coded through `isActive`
New workspace, the New project `SidebarGroupAction` and every project row and account `DropdownMenuItem` have no handler yet

whenNotToUse.when: A nav that narrows to a column of icons with hover names when collapsed

name: c-sidebar-2
title: Icon rail that collapses
label: Icon Rail
description: Labels give way to tooltips at 3rem, with a rail and a trigger to drive it.

guidance.bestFor: Narrowing the nav to icons while the brand tile and account avatar stay in view, toggled by an edge strip or a header button
agentNotes: On the radix twin a row `tooltip` throws without a `TooltipProvider` above it; keep the one the example mounts or hoist it to your app root
Give each new row a `tooltip`, since at 3rem the label is clipped and the tooltip is the only name a pointer user sees
The collapsed state resets on reload; read the `sidebar_state` cookie on the server and pass it as `defaultOpen`

whenNotToUse.when: A nav with no icon state that holds a workspace switcher and project row menus

name: c-sidebar-3
title: Documentation nav with sub-menus
label: Docs Navigation
description: A search field, sections that collapse and a sub-tree under the current page.

guidance.bestFor: An always open panel with no toggle where typing opens every section that still matches, with the current page trail open on load
agentNotes: Replace `SECTIONS` with your page tree; sections and sub-trees start open around the child marked `isActive`, so set it from the current route
With `collapsible` none the panel stays a 16rem column on phones and never becomes a `Sheet`; add your own mobile toggle

whenNotToUse.when: Page hierarchies nested more than 2 levels deep

name: c-sidebar-4
title: Right-hand inspector panel
label: Inspector Panel
description: A floating off-canvas panel with row actions, linked counts and a status badge.

guidance.bestFor: Issue details beside the record: assignees with owner and remove actions, linked work, an activity feed and an Open in board button
agentNotes: Render `SidebarInset` before `Sidebar`: `side` right only pins the panel, and the child order decides which edge reserves its column
Replace `ASSIGNEES`, `LINKED` and `ACTIVITY`; the In review `Badge`, the ENG-2481 key and the issue text are fixed in the markup
Make owner, Notify, Remove, the add assignee `SidebarGroupAction` and Open in board run nothing yet; wire each to your API

whenNotToUse.when: A details panel laid over the page and closed by a click outside
Page navigation for the whole app along the left edge

name: c-sidebar-5
title: Filtering, loading and empty states
label: Filter & Loading
description: A filter field, skeleton rows while a refresh runs, and a real empty state.

guidance.bestFor: A project list whose pinned rows survive any query, with a refresh spinner, a clear button in the search box and a plan usage footer
agentNotes: `startRefresh` only shows skeletons for 900 ms on a `setTimeout`; replace it with your fetch and drive `loading` from that request
Keep `loading` false on the first render: `SidebarMenuSkeleton` picks a random width, so server and client HTML would differ
Replace `PINNED`, `PROJECTS` and `RUNS`; each `open` count and the 8 of 10 projects line are fixed, and Upgrade plan has no handler

whenNotToUse.when: A search over nested pages that also expands the sections holding each match
